summary: Nine-phase plan (13.5h, complex) landing exactly the machine-checkable split the research report established, and stopping where the report showed the tree structurally cannot go. FIVE DELIVERABLES: (1) Phase 4 -- the reduction TMCompleteBase <-> ForwardBase plus its .Discrete mirror, stated as an equivalence between two UNASSERTED Props so the hard constraint is honoured and strengthened; requires one new mirror bridge lemma blValidDiscrete_iff_validDiscrete_tr. (2) Phase 5 -- BLValid (Sp phi psi) from a new order-theoretic dichotomy lemma, then sp_translate via blValid_iff_valid_tr + BXCanonical.completeness, giving CEB's TM+ half without any TMP-NB/M5 dependence. (3) Phase 6 -- bl_soundness_discrete_succ at [SuccOrder][PredOrder] only, proved by induction (NOT composition, since soundness_discrete carries the very binders being dropped); net new content is the DF lemma and its PredOrder past-dual. (4) Phase 7 -- the Z1 countermodel at Q x_lex Z over multiFamTaskFrameGen, closing CEF with both halves in-tree and refuting TM_f weak completeness over Z-time, stated as the negation of Phase 4's TMCompleteDiscrete so the phases visibly compose. (5) Phase 8 -- Conservativity.lean docstring corrected to be row-dependent, plus the two live-paper facts (def:TMplus-f's Holder pin to Z-time; the commented line 4614 giving the author's own OPEN verdict for TM_f over the full discrete class). CEB IS AN EXPLICIT NON-GOAL, on the report's evidence: a follow-up task for the native BL soundness layer is proposed in Phase 8 but not scheduled. Two supporting phases: Phase 1 (Lemma A dichotomy -- confirmed genuinely absent, since the tree's complete_duration_discrete_or_dense assumes lub) and Phase 2 (Prod.Lex Succ/Pred instances for the pinned Mathlib gap, with the report's bare-successor-hypothesis fallback documented as a plan-level contingency). Phase 9 is tree-wide acceptance including a hard-constraint grep. Plan validates PASS with 0 warnings.

hard_constraint_status: HONOURED. No forward-conservativity theorem is planned anywhere. Phase 4's reduction asserts neither side and needs no sorry. Phase 6's rollback clause explicitly instructs the implementer to mark the phase [BLOCKED] rather than discharge bl_soundness_discrete_succ with sorry, because a sorry there would propagate into Phase 7's not_bl_derivable_z1 and manufacture an unsound refutation -- precisely the failure mode the prohibition exists to prevent. Phase 9 includes a tree-wide grep for any sorry adjacent to a forward-shaped statement.
